name: Zarithax the Golden
title: Scalekeeper
description: A golden-scaled dragonborn whose presence commands respect. Zarithax's eyes shimmer with an inner fire, and their voice carries the weight of ancient draconic authority.

greeting.first_time: I am Zarithax, Scalekeeper of the Ember Vault. You stand in a place of fire and honor, where the relics of dragonborn bloodlines are preserved. State your purpose.
greeting.returning: The flames remember you. Your vault remains sealed and protected.
greeting.native_race: Greetings, kin. Your ancestral vault awaits, as it has for generations.

about_service.text: The Ember Vault was forged in dragonfire and sealed by the ancient pact. Those who carry dragonborn blood may claim a vault here by birthright—it is our heritage, passed down through flame and scale. Outsiders seeking to use our vaults must undergo the Flamebinding Rite and pay the appropriate tribute.

ask_about_rite.text: The rite is simple and the rite is expensive, as all good rites are. A hundred gold: some for the ember-wax, the rest for the hoard. The hoard respects what glitters. It is not personal.

pay_rite.text: Ssss... the wax takes the gold, and the seal takes your name. Welcome to the Ember Vault, which is a grand name for something I should tell you plainly: it is not a room. It is the same warded hollow every keeper opens. I hold a key. So does the orc in his swamp, unfortunately. Your treasures are safe from all of us.
pay_rite.success: Zarithax sealed your rite at the Ember Vault. You may store items here.
pay_rite.failure: A hundred gold. The hoard does not haggle.

use_storage.text: The flames will part for you. Enter, and know that your possessions are secure — though not, strictly, here. The Ember Vault is a key, not a chamber. Every keeper turns the same lock. Your hoard follows you across the realm, which is either a marvel or a filing convenience, depending on your temperament.

maybe_later.text: The flames are patient. Return when you are prepared.

goodbye.text: May the fire within you burn eternal. Farewell.

claim_birthright.text: Ahh — scale and ember, you are kin. Then the rite was performed for you at hatching and the seal bears your bloodline already. Keep your gold. Even I do not charge the hoard's own children.
claim_birthright.success: Your bloodline's seal was already set in the Ember Vault.
claim_birthright.failure: There seems to be some irregularity. Speak with me again.

homeward_stone.text: A Homeward Stone is an ember-scale from the hoard, bonded to the waystone in Goldenhaven's square. Every dragonborn of the city holds one; it carries you home once each week. Others may hold one when they've earned the hoard's trust. Trust, here, is earned in trade.

options.label: [Dragonborn] My ember-scale was never given to me.

homeward_gift.text: Then the hoard has kept it warm for you. Take it, kin. One is given freely. A second is a purchase like any other.

homeward_shop.text: Ember-scales, each bonded to Goldenhaven's waystone. One to a hand, and the hoard sets the price.
